name: agentyard
description: A pixel-art view of your agent company, in the VS Code panel. Works with Claude Code and Codex.

agentyard.agents.description: Which coding-agent backends Agentyard works with. Drives the Run-view switcher, which guideline files the guidelines command manages, and which live sources are watched. An existing install stays Claude-Code-only until this is changed.

agentyard.dbPath.description: Path to company.db relative to the first workspace folder.

agentyard.agentsGlob.description: Folder that holds the department agent .md files, relative to the first workspace folder.

agentyard.pollSeconds.description: How often to re-read the DB and agent files.

agentyard.idleSeconds.description: An agent with no tool activity for this many seconds is shown as idle.

agentyard.staleMinutes.description: A live agent that never reported finishing and has had no activity for this many minutes is treated as a zombie (its VS Code was force-closed mid-run) and dropped from the scene. 0 disables the check.

agentyard.staleWorkingHours.description: A company.db status_log 'working' row older than this many hours renders as idle (the session likely ended without logging idle). 0 disables.

agentyard.maxSpritesPerRoom.description: A room busier than this shows the first N agents and a "+N more" tile.

agentyard.claudePath.description: Command used to run the Claude Code CLI for the Run view. A bare name is looked up on PATH; on Windows Agentyard also tries claude.exe and claude.cmd. Uses your existing CLI login — no API key.

agentyard.claudeExtraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended verbatim when the Run view launches the Claude Code CLI, e.g. ["--model", "opus"] or ["--allowedTools", "Read Edit Bash(npm test)"].

agentyard.codexPath.description: Command used to run the Codex CLI for the Run view. A bare name is looked up on PATH; on Windows Agentyard also tries codex.exe and codex.cmd. Uses your existing CLI login — no API key.

agentyard.codexExtraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended verbatim when the Run view launches the Codex CLI. Anything Codex needs (model, sandbox, approval flags) goes here — Agentyard does not map any Codex flags by default.

agentyard.claudePermissionMode.description: Passed as --permission-mode when the Run view launches Claude Code. Left as `default`, no flag is added. `plan` starts the session in plan mode. `bypassPermissions` skips all permission checks — only use it in a workspace you trust.

agentyard.runView.description: `terminal` (default) runs an interactive Claude Code session in a real embedded terminal — permission prompts are answered in the panel. `headless` keeps the older non-interactive `claude -p` feed. Agentyard falls back to `headless` automatically if the native terminal component cannot load on this platform.

agentyard.terminalCopyPaste.description: Handle Ctrl/Cmd+C (copy the selection, or pass through as SIGINT when nothing is selected), Ctrl+Shift+C (always copy), and Ctrl/Cmd+V / Ctrl+Shift+V / Shift+Insert (paste) in the Run-view terminal. Clipboard access goes through VS Code.

agentyard.copyOnSelection.description: When true, selecting text in the Run-view terminal copies it to the clipboard immediately (no Ctrl+C needed).

agentyard.attachmentsDir.description: Folder, relative to the first workspace folder, where the Run view writes pasted or dropped images before inserting their path into the prompt.

agentyard.keepAttachments.description: When false, Agentyard clears the attachments folder when the Run view initialises and on "New thread". Set true to keep pasted/dropped image files.

agentyard.maxAttachmentMB.description: Reject a pasted or dropped attachment larger than this many megabytes.
